title: Spot HTTP regression investigation and PostgreSQL projection round-trip optimization

status.historical_27_percent_regression: not reproduced as a stable code regression in request-paired controls
status.spot_http_gain: confirmed in all four request-paired fix runs

findings.historical_sample: Previous two-per-version serial batches reported spot 193.36 -> 140.46 requests/s (-27%). That observation remains preserved in the earlier report.
findings.same_binary_variability: In this run, the unchanged pre-fix binary spans 138.30 to 261.93 requests/s in serial cases. An unrelated worktree was compiling/testing PostgreSQL on the same host during serial measurements; its processes were not stopped. Pinning process CPU does not isolate disk, other work, or power/frequency effects.
findings.history_control: Two controls alternate stage-2 and pre-fix requests at every command, reversing AB/BA order. Their throughput ratios are 0.9787 and 0.9933, median throughput difference about -1.4%; this does not support attributing the earlier -27% to history storage. It does not identify a unique historical environmental cause.
findings.benchmark_launch_fix: Historical harness changed process affinity after Popen; child initialization/descendant creation could happen first. The new harness creates only owned children suspended, sets affinity, and resumes their primary thread before initialization. Affinity inheritance was checked in an owned child. This removes a measurement race; no claim that it specifically caused the historical -27%.
findings.bottleneck: Pre-fix diagnostic spans: journal about 67%, preparation/auth/lock about 31%, candidate application about 2%. SQL-string execution in the locked postgres driver separately prepares every projection statement before execution.
findings.implementation: 8 fixed-schema projection writes use execute_typed with explicit migration-compatible parameter types. Parse/Bind/Execute can be sent together. This avoids a separate preparation round trip; it is not a persistent prepared-statement cache and does not remove server-side SQL parsing.
findings.unchanged_contracts: SQL text, parameter values/order, error paths, transaction begin/commit/rollback, unique/idempotency checks, projection order, journal durability and clearing behavior are preserved. No schema/fee/account/orderbook changes.

paired_performance.scope: Release loopback HTTP/1.1 persistent connection, real private PostgreSQL with default durability. 8 funded accounts, 100 live orders, initially 10 levels per side. 1819 deterministic mixed limit/cancel/amend/market commands per case (400 cycles) with growing histories and replenishment. Setup, response JSON validation, SQL digest checks and restarts excluded from request timing; request through full response body included. No dedicated warm-up; cold first requests retained.
paired_performance.control: Two API processes stay alive with separate fresh databases on one private PG cluster. At each command requests execute sequentially AB/BA, alternating first version and reversing starting parity across runs. No overlapping timed order requests. CPU masks: API 4, PG parent/descendants 16, client 64, applied before initialization. This compares service costs under similar instantaneous host conditions; it is not concurrent client capacity, open-loop queueing or a dedicated-host benchmark.
paired_performance.aggregation: Median of per-case service-time throughput and nearest-rank percentiles. Percentile medians are not pooled quantiles. Per-command paired samples and per-run ratios retained; no samples or slow runs discarded.

serial_comparison.qualification: diagnostic only; strong same-binary variation, including a slow fixed run, retained without filtering

handler_diagnostics.scope: Only disposable local server copies emit per-request nanosecond spans to a log. No timing/log instrumentation remains in production source/binary. Three complete spot streams before and after. Diagnostic builds use alias package version 0.0.3; measurements are separate, not paired, and are not the speed qualification.

receipt.test: entire exchange-server library, single harness thread

correctness.persisted_projection_equivalence: Seven projection tables (executions/orders/order_events/trades/market_ticks/account_ledger/position_snapshots) are compared by ordered canonical JSON hashes with created_at/updated_at omitted. All spot versions match; all perp versions match. Paired command indices, sequences, action types and trade counts match exactly.
correctness.sql_structural_check: Strip explicit Type annotations/comment and restore execute method names: all 8 hot write bodies match pre-fix source after whitespace normalization. Parameter ordering and all checks/error paths remain identical.

import http.client
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import statistics
import hashlib
from owned_process import launch
import subprocess
import time
import sys
import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes

kernel=ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True)
kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask.argtypes=[wintypes.HANDLE,ctypes.c_size_t]
kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask.restype=wintypes.BOOL
kernel.GetCurrentProcess.restype=wintypes.HANDLE
assert kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask(kernel.GetCurrentProcess(),64), ctypes.get_last_error()
memory = '--memory' in sys.argv

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
pgbin = Path('D:/SQL/bin')
data = out / 'http-postgres-data'
trace = json.loads((out/'http-trace.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('MARKETFORGE_', 'PG'))}
flags = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW

def port():
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return s.getsockname()[1]

def control(args):
    with (out/'http-pg-control.log').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as log:
        process=launch([str(x) for x in args],16,env=env,cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        assert process.wait(timeout=60)==0

def stats(values):
    values = sorted(values)
    return {'count':len(values), **{f'p{p}_us':values[math.ceil(len(values)*p/100)-1] for p in [50,95,99]},
            'max_us':values[-1], 'http_commands_per_second':len(values)*1e6/sum(values)}

def payloads():
    owners = {o['NewOrder']['order_id']:o['NewOrder']['account_id'] for o in trace['seed_orders']}
    result = []
    for command, expected in trace['trace']:
        kind, value = next(iter(command.items()))
        if kind == 'NewOrder':
            owners[value['order_id']] = value['account_id']
            account = value['account_id']
            action = {'side':value['side'], 'qty':value['qty']}
            if value['kind'] == 'Market':
                action = {'PlaceMarket':action}
            else:
                action['price_tick'] = value['kind']['Limit']['price_tick']
                action = {'PlaceLimit':action}
        else:
            account = owners[value['order_id']]
            action = {('Cancel' if kind == 'CancelOrder' else 'Amend'):
                      {k:v for k,v in value.items() if k != 'account_id'}}
        request = {'participant_id':'mixed-benchmark', 'account_id':account, 'action':action}
        result.append((json.dumps(request).encode(),expected))
    return result

requests = payloads()
PAIR = None

def normalized_expected(events):
    return [{'type':kind, **value} for event in events for kind,value in event.items()]

def scenario(mode):
    instrument = {'instrument_id':'BENCH', 'symbol':'BENCH', 'base_asset':'BASE',
                  'quote_asset':'QUOTE', 'venue_id':'default-venue', 'tick_size':1,'lot_size':1}
    market = {'instrument':instrument,'clearing':{'maker_fee_ppm':0,'taker_fee_ppm':0},
              'risk':({'allow_short':False} if mode == 'Spot' else {})}
    if mode == 'Perp':
        market['clearing']['leverage'] = 1
        market['initial_mark_price_tick'] = 1000
    accounts = [{('Spot' if mode == 'Spot' else 'Basic'):{'account_id':i,'cash_balance':1_000_000_000_000,
                       **({'position_qty':10_000_000} if mode == 'Spot' else {})}}
                for i in range(1,9)]
    return {'room_id':'mixed', 'market':{mode:market},'accounts':accounts,'seed_orders':trace['seed_orders']}

def case(variant, mode, number, pgport):
    name = f'mixed_{number}_{variant}_{mode.lower()}' + ('_memory' if memory else '')
    if not memory:
        control([pgbin/'createdb.exe','-h','127.0.0.1','-p',pgport,'-U','forge',name])
    bind = port()
    caseenv = env | {'MARKETFORGE_BIND_ADDR':f'127.0.0.1:{bind}'}
    if not memory:
        caseenv['MARKETFORGE_DATABASE_URL'] = f'postgresql://forge@127.0.0.1:{pgport}/{name}'
    workdir = out / name
    workdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    binary = out / f'{variant}-server.exe'
    process = None
    conn = None
    log = (out/f'{name}.log').open('w',encoding='utf-8')
    def stop():
        nonlocal process, conn
        if conn:
            conn.close()
            conn = None
        if process and process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
            process.wait(timeout=20)
        process = None
    def start():
        nonlocal process, conn
        process = launch([str(binary)],4,env=caseenv,cwd=workdir,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        deadline = time.monotonic()+25
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            assert process.poll() is None, 'server exited, see '+str(log.name)
            try:
                c = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',bind,timeout=20)
                c.request('GET','/health/ready')
                r = c.getresponse()
                r.read()
                c.close()
                if r.status==200:
                    conn = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',bind,timeout=20)
                    return
            except OSError:
                pass
            time.sleep(.05)
        raise RuntimeError('server readiness exceeded 25 seconds')
    def request(method,path,body=None,key=None):
        headers = {'Content-Type':'application/json'}
        if key:
            headers['Idempotency-Key'] = key
        paired = PAIR is not None and key is not None and key.startswith('command-') and not PAIR.complete
        if paired:
            PAIR.wait_turn(variant,int(key.split('-')[1]))
        start_ns = time.perf_counter_ns()
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers=headers)
        response = conn.getresponse()
        raw = response.read()
        us = (time.perf_counter_ns()-start_ns)/1000
        if paired:
            PAIR.done(variant)
        decoded = json.loads(raw)
        assert 200<=response.status<300, (response.status,decoded)
        return decoded,us
    try:
        start()
        request('POST','/rooms',json.dumps({'scenario':scenario(mode),'agents':[],
                                         'autostart_agents':False}).encode())
        times=[]
        categories={}
        last=None
        samples=[]
        for index,(body,expected) in enumerate(requests):
            key=f'command-{index}'
            receipt,us=request('POST','/rooms/mixed/instruments/BENCH/orders',body,key)
            assert receipt['accepted'], (index,receipt)
            normalized=[{k:v for k,v in event.items() if k!='seq'} for event in receipt['events']]
            assert normalized==normalized_expected(expected), (index,normalized,expected)
            times.append(us)
            samples.append({"index":index,"command_seq":receipt["command_seq"],"us":us,"action":next(iter(json.loads(body)["action"])),"trades":sum(e["type"]=="TradePrinted" for e in receipt["events"])})
            kind=next(iter(json.loads(body)['action']))
            categories.setdefault(kind,[]).append(us)
            last=(body,key,receipt)
        if PAIR is not None:
            PAIR.wait_complete()
        book,_=request('GET','/rooms/mixed/instruments/BENCH/book')
        assert book==trace['final_book'], (book,trace['final_book'])
        # Recovery is outside timed request samples. Terminate only this owned
        # process after all acknowledged commands, then recover from real PG.
        if not memory:
            stop()
            start()
        recovered,_=request('GET','/rooms/mixed/instruments/BENCH/book')
        assert recovered==book
        replayed,_=request('POST','/rooms/mixed/instruments/BENCH/orders',last[0],last[1])
        assert replayed==last[2]
        unchanged,_=request('GET','/rooms/mixed/instruments/BENCH/book')
        assert unchanged==book
        (out/(name+'-samples.json')).write_text(json.dumps(samples))
        projection_hashes={}
        if not memory:
            for table in ['executions','orders','order_events','trades','market_ticks','account_ledger','position_snapshots']:
                query=f"SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item::text),'[]'::jsonb)::text FROM (SELECT to_jsonb(t)-'created_at'-'updated_at' AS item FROM marketforge_{table} AS t) AS rows"
                values=subprocess.check_output([str(pgbin/'psql.exe'),'-h','127.0.0.1','-p',str(pgport),'-U','forge','-d',name,'-At','-c',query],env=env,cwd=root,creationflags=flags,timeout=30)
                decoded=json.loads(values)
                projection_hashes[table]={'rows':len(decoded),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(decoded,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()}
        row={'projection_hashes':projection_hashes,'variant':variant,'mode':mode,'run':number,'commands':len(times),'latency':stats(times),
             'operations':{k:stats(v) for k,v in categories.items()},
             'all_events_and_final_book_match':True,'postgres_restart_recovery':not memory,
             'idempotency_replay':True}
        print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
        return row
    finally:
        stop()
        log.close()

"""Pin owned children before their first instruction (including descendants)."""
import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes
import subprocess

k=ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True)
k.SetProcessAffinityMask.argtypes=[wintypes.HANDLE,ctypes.c_size_t]
k.SetProcessAffinityMask.restype=wintypes.BOOL
k.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot.argtypes=[wintypes.DWORD,wintypes.DWORD]
k.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot.restype=wintypes.HANDLE
k.OpenThread.argtypes=[wintypes.DWORD,wintypes.BOOL,wintypes.DWORD]
k.OpenThread.restype=wintypes.HANDLE
k.ResumeThread.argtypes=[wintypes.HANDLE]
k.ResumeThread.restype=wintypes.DWORD
k.CloseHandle.argtypes=[wintypes.HANDLE]
class ThreadEntry(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('dwSize',wintypes.DWORD),('cntUsage',wintypes.DWORD),
              ('th32ThreadID',wintypes.DWORD),('th32OwnerProcessID',wintypes.DWORD),
              ('tpBasePri',wintypes.LONG),('tpDeltaPri',wintypes.LONG),('dwFlags',wintypes.DWORD)]
k.Thread32First.argtypes=[wintypes.HANDLE,ctypes.POINTER(ThreadEntry)]
k.Thread32Next.argtypes=[wintypes.HANDLE,ctypes.POINTER(ThreadEntry)]

def launch(args,affinity,**kwargs):
    p=subprocess.Popen(args,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW|0x00000004,**kwargs)
    snapshot=None
    try:
        assert k.SetProcessAffinityMask(p._handle,affinity),ctypes.get_last_error()
        snapshot=k.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(4,0)
        assert snapshot!=wintypes.HANDLE(-1).value,ctypes.get_last_error()
        entry=ThreadEntry();entry.dwSize=ctypes.sizeof(entry)
        found=k.Thread32First(snapshot,ctypes.byref(entry));resumed=0
        while found:
            if entry.th32OwnerProcessID==p.pid:
                thread=k.OpenThread(2,False,entry.th32ThreadID)
                assert thread,ctypes.get_last_error()
                try:
                    previous=k.ResumeThread(thread)
                    assert previous!=0xFFFFFFFF,ctypes.get_last_error()
                    resumed+=int(previous>0)
                finally:
                    k.CloseHandle(thread)
            found=k.Thread32Next(snapshot,ctypes.byref(entry))
        assert resumed==1,('owned child primary thread not resumed',p.pid,resumed)
        return p
    except BaseException:
        p.kill();p.wait(timeout=20)
        raise
    finally:
        if snapshot:
            k.CloseHandle(snapshot)

import concurrent.futures
import json
import threading
import http_harness as h

class Pair:
    def __init__(self,variants,parity):
        self.variants=variants
        self.parity=parity
        self.index=0
        self.phase=0
        self.complete=False
        self.error=None
        self.condition=threading.Condition()
    def turn(self):
        first=(self.index+self.parity)%2
        return self.variants[first if self.phase==0 else 1-first]
    def wait_turn(self,variant,index):
        with self.condition:
            assert self.condition.wait_for(lambda:self.error or (self.index==index and self.turn()==variant),timeout=30)
            if self.error:
                raise RuntimeError(self.error)
    def done(self,variant):
        with self.condition:
            assert self.turn()==variant
            self.phase+=1
            if self.phase==2:
                self.index+=1
                self.phase=0
                self.complete=self.index==len(h.requests)
            self.condition.notify_all()
    def wait_complete(self):
        with self.condition:
            assert self.condition.wait_for(lambda:self.error or self.complete,timeout=30)
            if self.error:
                raise RuntimeError(self.error)
    def abort(self,error):
        with self.condition:
            self.error=str(error)
            self.condition.notify_all()

assert not (h.data/'postmaster.pid').exists()
pgport=h.port()
started=False
rows=[]
try:
    h.control([h.pgbin/'pg_ctl.exe','-D',h.data,'-w','-t','20','-l',h.out/'http-postgres.log',
               '-o',f'-h 127.0.0.1 -p {pgport}','start'])
    started=True
    cases=[(['stage2','before'],'Spot'),(['stage2','before'],'Spot')]
    cases += [(['before','after'],'Spot')]*4
    cases += [(['before','after'],'Perp')]*2
    for number,(variants,mode) in enumerate(cases,start=500):
        pair=Pair(variants,number%2)
        h.PAIR=pair
        def worker(variant):
            try:
                return h.case(variant,mode,number,pgport)
            except BaseException as e:
                pair.abort(e)
                raise
        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
            futures=[pool.submit(worker,v) for v in variants]
            results=[f.result() for f in futures]
        assert results[0]['projection_hashes']==results[1]['projection_hashes']
        rows.extend(results)
        (h.out/'interleaved-partial.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
        print('completed paired run',number,mode,variants,flush=True)
    (h.out/'interleaved-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
finally:
    if started:
        h.control([h.pgbin/'pg_ctl.exe','-D',h.data,'-w','-t','20','-m','fast','stop'])

from http_harness import *
assert not (data/'postmaster.pid').exists()
pgport=port()
started=False
try:
    control([pgbin/'pg_ctl.exe','-D',data,'-w','-t','20','-l',out/'http-postgres.log','-o',f'-h 127.0.0.1 -p {pgport}','start'])
    started=True
    rows=[]
    variants=['stage2','before','after','after','before','stage2','before','stage2','after','after','stage2','before']
    for i,variant in enumerate(variants,start=300):
        rows.append(case(variant,'Spot',i,pgport))
        (out/'comparison-partial.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
    assert len({json.dumps(r['projection_hashes'],sort_keys=True) for r in rows})==1,'durable projections differ across variants'
    for i,variant in enumerate(['before','after','after','before'],start=400):
        rows.append(case(variant,'Perp',i,pgport))
    perps=[r for r in rows if r['mode']=='Perp']
    assert len({json.dumps(r['projection_hashes'],sort_keys=True) for r in perps})==1,'perp projections differ'
    (out/'comparison-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
finally:
    if started:
        control([pgbin/'pg_ctl.exe','-D',data,'-w','-t','20','-m','fast','stop'])
